summary: The speaker ḥḏo mak kačkat is the only overt participant of manṭaqla. Although assigned stem III, the predicate is intransitive here: the form does not by itself license a causative 'make someone speak' sense.

The sequencing after the preceding speech and before məlla is compatible with taking a speaking turn. One speech-introducing occurrence cannot establish an independent lexical meaning 'begin' beyond the existing reden gloss.
